projects.name: M.A.R.I.A — IBM Watson Voice Assistant
projects.tldr: Led delivery of M.A.R.I.A, a real-time voice assistant for Banco Montepio's contact center, built on IBM Watson.
projects.description: M.A.R.I.A (Montepio's Automated Real-Time Interaction Assistant) is a cognitive voice agent built on IBM Watson Assistant for Voice, integrated into Banco Montepio's contact-center IVR to automate customer interactions — from card activation to account confirmations.
achievements: Automated 72 customer intentions in the contact center, incl. card activation and account confirmations
Targeted ~80% of call center workflow automation within a year of launch
Doubled FTE savings for the client’s call center (50k+ calls/month)

news.title: Nova assistente interativa do Montepio chama-se M.A.R.I.A e é "filha" do Watson da IBM

projects.name: BIA & Beatriz — Bankinter Voice Assistants
projects.tldr: Built BIA and Beatriz, AI phone-banking assistants for Bankinter and Bankinter Consumer Finance, on the same IBM automation platform as M.A.R.I.A.
projects.description: BIA (Bankinter) and Beatriz (Bankinter Consumer Finance) answer Bankinter's phone-banking line, authenticate callers, resolve frequent requests (card unlock/activation, balance checks, digital-channel enrollment, app/homebanking support), and route complex cases to human agents with context attached — voice-to-text, ML conversation orchestration, and text-to-voice, running on the same underlying platform later reused for Banco Montepio's M.A.R.I.A.
achievements: Cover ~40% of frequent customer contact scenarios
~70% of calls fully resolved without a human transfer

news.title: BIA e Beatriz são as assistentes digitais que já respondem a 40% dos casos de interações com clientes do Bankinter
